blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— The Department of Education (DepEd) emphasized the vital role of public-private partnerships in driving nationwide digital transformation. DepEd issued that statement on Thursday, as public schools in the National Capital Region, including those in Navotas City and Caloocan City, received 133 information and communications technology (ICT) units. Education Secretary Sonny Angara led the ceremonial turnover of the ICT equipment, accompanied by officials from the IT and Business Process Association of the Philippines (IBPAP).
